capabilities: Merge cells and mark row headers or multiple header rows with <, ^ and || markers
Edit cells and add, move, merge, split or delete rows and columns in Live Preview
Transpose a whole table while keeping headers and merges
Convert tables between structural Markdown, plain GFM and HTML
Export a table as PNG or convert it into an Obsidian Base
extras: Supports desktop Obsidian and Android only; PNG export is desktop-only. The README includes an apology that the extended syntax is not GFM-compatible and may not display correctly in other Markdown editors, which the Markdown/HTML conversion is meant to address. All processing is local.
motivation: The author built it as a small tool for their own needs while working with academic papers in Obsidian, using a small part of LaTeX as a practical substitute for extending Markdown.
problem: Plain Markdown tables cannot express merged cells, several header rows or row headers, so complex tables lose their structure in Obsidian.

relations.evidence: DocWen Assistant can work with the separate local DocWen application

summary: Adds merged cells, multi-row headers, row headers and headerless tables to Markdown tables, with in-place cell editing in Live Preview.
